purpose: Screen ACE as an independent ICLR 2026 persistent-artifact carrier/positive-control candidate while Skill-Pro P1 is runtime-blocked. This is source-level qualification only; no ACE experiment is authorized.

carrier.name: ACE — Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models

official_source_observations.persistent_representation: The playbook is a persistent structured context made of bullet records formatted as [id] helpful=X harmful=Y :: content.
official_source_observations.identity_and_credit: The official README states each bullet has an ID for tracking and helpful/harmful counts updated by the Reflector; reflector.py returns bullet_tags containing id/tag pairs.
official_source_observations.evolution_loop: Generator -> Reflector -> Curator; Curator maintains ADD/UPDATE/MERGE/DELETE operations and the playbook persists across adaptation.
official_source_observations.dedup_option: The official ACE constructor/config exposes use_bulletpoint_analyzer=False by default, threshold=0.90.
official_source_observations.dedup_operator: When enabled, BulletpointAnalyzer embeds bullet content, groups similar entries, and merges a group into one bullet while summing helpful and harmful counters across members and retaining the first bullet ID.
official_source_observations.dedup_timing: In ace.py, the optional BulletpointAnalyzer runs after the Curator step and before post-curator generation for that training sample.
official_source_observations.downstream_logs: Official outputs include bullet_usage_log.jsonl, curator_operations_diff.jsonl, detailed LLM logs, intermediate playbooks, and AppWorld evaluation support.

why_relevant: current-year flagship method with a broad self-improving-context audience
persistent symbolic IDs and per-ID feedback counters are first-party objects
exact-content duplicate bullets admit a clean representation refinement intervention
the optional analyzer explicitly implements a semantic merge that sums additive counters, making ACE unusually useful for distinguishing mere duplicate recognition from state-preserving composition
stri_relevance.operator_prediction: For additive helpful/harmful counters, summing counters before a downstream counter-dependent decision is merge-sufficient. If duplicate identities are allowed to accumulate independent counters before a non-mergeable local decision, representation dependence remains possible. The exact ACE load-bearing decision seam must be pinned before any stronger claim.
stri_relevance.valuable_control: Compare default analyzer-off behavior with analyzer-on state reunion under an exact-clone intervention, but do not call analyzer-on a native robustness result until the exact ordering relative to the target downstream decision is qualified.

qualification_gaps: The current official repository has not yet been pinned to an exact commit/hash in the research system because remote git/codeload access was transiently failing during this audit.
No exact curator/pruning decision has yet been identified whose outcome provably depends only on retained per-ID counters and can be tested without LLM semantic confounding.
The optional analyzer uses embeddings and an LLM merge, so exact-content equivalence must be tested separately from approximate semantic grouping.
No zero-provider author-operator intervention has been executed yet.
No AppWorld representation-refinement behavior has been run.
